newsitem.title: CHINA: China calls for calm, investigating Korea crisis.
newsitem.headline: China calls for calm, investigating Korea crisis.

text.p: China called for calm on Thursday amid reports that a top North Korean official had sought asylum in South Korea's embassy in Beijing, saying it was investigating the situation.
"Regarding the passage through Beijing city by Hwang Jang-yop, we were not notified in advance," a Foreign Ministry spokeswoman said.
"We are currently investigating and verifying reports about this matter," she said.

"We hope the parties concerned can deal with this matter calmly and on the basis of the overall circumstances, and appropriately handle this in the interests of the peace and stability of the Korean peninsula," she said.
